science: Both controls include exact continuum spectral weight and all localized poles/residues. The source fills the coupled normal modes with Fermi factors. The explicit product preparation followed by unitary quench instead fixes localized occupations from initial covariance projections, with unchanged thermal incoming continuum. Cesaro averaging removes distinct-energy cross terms, not population memory. Independent tridiagonal finite-chain covariance projection and thermodynamic extrapolation agree.
public_input_review: Exact quadratic Hamiltonian, sign conventions, initially occupied orbital and independent grand-canonical chain, sudden contact, subsequent unitary dynamics, chemical potential zero, thermodynamic-before-Cesaro readout and hardware settings are specified. No bound-mode diagnosis or corrective occupation appears publicly. Exact neutral instruction permits all code changes; only public files enter image; ordinary fit stub and complete separate Gibbs baseline.
calibration_review: 288 weak-contact records at nine positive-energy/temperature settings. No bound poles anywhere in allowed coupling range on calibration, so both controls exactly coincide. Every calibration curve is monotone with minimum derivative0.03167. Fixed sigma0.0005 independent of parameter/output;256 noisy fits and full-range noiseless recovery pass.
grading_review: Four-percent gate retained. All256 oracle groups pass; source strong-contact errors at least0.33226. Independent hidden absolute disagreement8.77e-7, reference size refinement7.65e-7, quadrature1.1e-14. Public controls avoid pole thresholds by minimum gap0.078. limit_order_review: For this local observable, continuum offdiagonal and initial-local contributions disperse, bound-continuum and distinct-pole terms vanish under time averaging, and localized projections converge exponentially with length. Finite-chain continuum corrections vanish as inverse length. This justifies the shared limiting local diagonal ensemble without asserting a generic interchange of size/time limits.
classification_caveat: Assigning thermal Fermi occupation to isolated normal modes despite specified unitary preparation is physical-model failure. Correct preparation overlap followed by residue, normalization, quadrature or finite-size mistakes is classified separately.
